channel.title: Palm Coast Observer - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Palm Coast Observer (observerlocalnews.com)

item.title: Volusia School Board members voice opposition to SB 1620
item.description: School Board members cited lack of 'safeguards' for student, staff personal information. Bill co-sponsors Sen. Tom Leek and Sen. Don Gaetz say the bill isn't specifically targeting Volusia.

item.title: Will Flagler County continue to fund its portion of the lifeguard program? Flagler Beach wants to know
item.description: Flagler County paid $106,000 to the program in the 2026 budget. Whether it will continue to do so in the future, will depend on the budget numbers.

item.title: Lori Tolland to speak at upcoming Citizens for Ormond Beach meeting
item.description: The deputy mayor will speak at the library on Feb. 11, from 5:30-6:30 p.m.

item.title: Flagler Beach signs on to tolling agreement with Flagler County, hoping to avoid lawsuit
item.description: The county began the conflict resolution process over disputes with the Summertown development in Flagler Beach on Jan. 28. Ironing out the issues through the tolling agreement would avoid a lawsuit.

item.title: Seabreeze paraprofessional arrested, Daytona police say he kicked student with Down syndrome
item.description: Dontel Wright, 50, remains in jail with no bond.

item.title: Volusia, Flagler County cold-weather shelters operational more than 12 days in 2026
item.description: Though not county-operated, the community-run cold-weather shelters work with their respective counties to provide warm shelter whenever the temperature drops below 40 degrees.

item.title: Daytona Beach man found guilty of first-degree murder in 2023 carjacking case
item.description: A jury found Latravius Jacobs guilty as charged of first-degree murder, vehicular homicide, carjacking and burglary of a conveyance. He'll be sentenced on Feb. 9.

item.title: Flagler County Sheriff's Office to increase patrols super bowl weekend
item.description: The FCSO will have increase patrols, dedicated DUI enforcement and educational displays over the course of the weekend.

item.title: Volusia County joins schools for tornado drill during Severe Weather Awareness Week
item.description: Volusia County’s Emergency Management Division participated in the statewide tornado drill as part of Florida Severe Weather Awareness Week.

item.title: Flagler Tourism Development Office release survey for county's long-term tourism plan
item.description: All survey responses are anonymous. Insights will play an essential role in helping develop a detailed 10-year Tourism Master Sustainability Plan, a TDO press release said.
